introHtml: Full color decoration brings your medical healthcare items to life with photorealistic detail, making your brand stand out on lanyards, badge reels, and more. Unlike one- or two-color imprints, full color allows you to reproduce logos, photos, and complex graphics with sharp clarity. This is ideal for healthcare organizations that want to convey a modern, professional image while ensuring their branded gear is easily recognizable. Whether you're outfitting staff at a hospital or distributing promotional items at a health fair, full color adds a level of polish that simple screen printing can't match.
